results.content: Donald Trump's popularity rebounded slightly in this week's Economist / YouGov Poll after his recent slump, but he remains deeply unpopular. This week's poll finds that 36% of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, and 57% disapprove — a net job approval of -21. That's an improvement for Trump from the week before, when 35% approved and 61% disapproved for a net approval of -26. Two weeks ago, Trump hit the lowest job approval numbers of either of his terms: 33% [...] A big component of Trump's increase in net job approval over the past week is a rise in support from Independents, who rose from a net approval of -53 last week to -38 this week. Trump’s job approval in August stands at 40%, while disapproval is at 59%. This is the same approval level as in July, while disapproval has increased one percentage point, from 58%. This ties the record low of approval in either Trump’s first or second terms, and is a new record low for his net approval, at -19 percentage points. results.content:
Just 39% of registered voters approve of Trump’s job performance, while 58% disapprove, putting him 19 points underwater, as detailed in a Noble Predictive Insights poll released Thursday. The net minus-19 rating drops below his previous low of minus-13, recorded after Jan. 6, 2021.

Trump receives a net minus-25 on both the economy and his handling of military operations in Iran, according to the poll results.
